COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 2600 of 2021
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. A.K. Sharma, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
Mr. R.C. Arya, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Issue notice to respondent no. 2 
returnable at an early date. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that learned Settlement Officer 
Consolidation has decided the case against 
the predecessor of petitioner, although 
Hon’ble Supreme Court has decided the 
controversy in their favour. He further 
submits that similar question is involved in 
WPMS No. 1917 of 2021. 
In such view of the matter, list this 
case along with WPMS No. 1917 of 2021.
Till the next date of listing, status quo 
qua possession over the land in question 
shall be maintained. 
Stay application (IA Nos. 1 of 2021) 
stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 08.12.2021
Aswal
